ubermensch: Ubermensch is a person with great powers and abilities.
Ubermensch means the same as demigod or superman.
ubiety: An ubiety is the state of existing and being localized in space.
ubiquinone: An ubiquinone is any of several quinones found in living cells and that function as coenzymes that transfer electrons from one molecule to another in cell respiration.
Ubiquinone means the same as coenzyme Q.
ubiquitousness: An ubiquitousness is the state of being everywhere at once.
Ubiquitousness means the same as ubiquity or omnipresence.
ubiquity: An ubiquity is the state of being everywhere at once.
Ubiquity means the same as ubiquitousness or omnipresence.
ubykh: Ubykh is an extinct Caucasian language spoken exclusively in Turkey.
ubiquitous: Ubiquitous means being present everywhere at once.
Ubiquitous means the same as omnipresent.
